description: GPT-4 Turbo is an optimized version of GPT-4 with vision capabilities, a 128K context window, and improved instruction following. It offers better performance at a lower cost than the original GPT-4.

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse mixture of licensed data, data created by human trainers, and publicly available data.

trainingProcedure: Trained using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). Optimized for reduced laziness and improved instruction following compared to earlier GPT-4 versions.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Improved instruction following and reduced 'laziness' compared to earlier GPT-4 versions. Strong performance across reasoning, coding, and creative tasks.

knownLimitations: May generate incorrect or misleading information
Knowledge limited to training data cutoff date
Can exhibit biases present in training data
Lower output token limit than GPT-4o

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: OpenAI has implemented safety mitigations through RLHF and content filtering.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built-in content filtering, usage policies enforcement, and refusal of harmful requests.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Data sent to the API may be used to improve the model unless opted out.
